query: INSERT INTO notification_preferences (user_id, daily_review_reminder_enabled, daily_review_reminder_time, weekly_digest_enabled, new_highlights_sync, feed_updates, marketing_emails, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET daily_review_reminder_enabled = EXCLUDED.daily_review_reminder_enabled, daily_review_reminder_time = EXCLUDED.daily_review_reminder_time, weekly_digest_enabled = EXCLUDED.weekly_digest_enabled, new_highlights_sync = EXCLUDED.new_highlights_sync, feed_updates = EXCLUDED.feed_updates, marketing_emails = EXCLUDED.marketing_emails, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at RETURNING user_id, daily_review_reminder_enabled, daily_review_reminder_time, weekly_digest_enabled, new_highlights_sync, feed_updates, marketing_emails, updated_at
